product: Gemini CLI (the bash gate the antigravity writer installs)
how: gemini --yolo -m gemini-2.5-flash --fake-responses <file> in a scratch project whose .gemini/settings.json registered an AfterTool command hook that wrote stdin to a file. The CLI, its shell tool and its hook runner are real; only the model's replies are scripted (two run_shell_command calls: printf of a cargo summary, exit 0; sh -c with a pytest summary and exit 1). transcript_path and cwd are redacted; nothing else is edited.
